method.note: Both directions scored on equal terms; the recent window decides and the long window is kept only to detect a regime turn. WAIT is only reachable when both directions lose.
method.walk: Bar by bar. A bar reaching both levels is charged to the stop. Unresolved positions close at the market, not at zero.
method.unavailable: Binance futures is geo-blocked from this host, so nothing here uses funding, open interest or liquidation data.
